title: Fictional sampling result for MOD-100 model governance and registry

assessor.name: Morgan Ellis
assessor.independence_statement: This fictional assessor has no operational ownership of the assessed Summit Analytics CAP-140 capability.

assessment_scope.subject: Fictional Summit Analytics workforce-research assistant CAP-140 model registry entry
assessment_scope.boundary: Model registry completeness, one-alias deployment reconciliation, and owner interview for CAP-140 during integrated engagement ENG-SA-2026-09-API100.
exclusions: Model validation depth under MOD-120 and retirement under MOD-150.
assessment_scope.population: Fictional MOD controls assigned to CAP-140.
assessment_scope.sample: MOD-100 only, with one fictional model alias; as selected in the integrated Draft sampling vignette.

methods.procedure: MOD-100-A1 - Examine completeness and approval of the fictional CAP-140 model registry record.
methods.object: Fictional registry record EVD-SAMP3-MOD100-REGISTRY, captured in the linked workbook evidence-record format.
methods.expected_result: Registry record includes unique identifier, owner, purpose, provider, version, lifecycle state, risk classification, validation status, deployment links, and review date.
methods.actual_work: Examined the fictional registry card for the single CAP-140 inference alias, including ownership, purpose, provider, version, lifecycle state, risk classification, validation status, deployment link, review date, and approval.

methods.procedure: MOD-100-A2 - Reconcile deployed model identifiers with the registry.
methods.object: Fictional production gateway model alias and registry identifier for CAP-140.
methods.expected_result: Deployed model identifier matches the approved registry entry.
methods.actual_work: Reconciled the deployed CAP-140 alias hash to the registry immutable identifier and found a match for the one sampled alias.

methods.procedure: MOD-100-A3 - Interview registry ownership and update triggers.
methods.expected_result: Registry ownership and update triggers are confirmed by the accountable owner.
methods.actual_work: Interviewed the fictional model owner about registry ownership and update triggers after a prompt-routing change; the owner described the trigger and the sample did not validate additional aliases.

determination_rationale: The fictional registry record for one alias was complete and approved, that alias's deployed identifier matched the registry, and the owner described the update trigger. The result remains Draft because the sample is limited to one alias and does not support broader generalization.
limitations: This fictional Draft deepen result does not assess a real organization.
Reconciliation covered only one fictional model alias for CAP-140; no portfolio-level or capability-wide conclusion is supported.
Interview evidence records the fictional owner's account and does not independently establish that all update triggers operate effectively.

change_history.author: Morgan Ellis
change_history.description: Retained the audit-owned fictional Draft MOD-100 result, bounded to one alias, with registry, reconciliation, and interview work.

example_notice: Fictional non-authoritative example; no organization, ESAF control, profile, or external framework has been assessed.
